audit_write_path.reason: 必须有 append-only audit log 且 dry-run production_writes=0

authority_not_shadow.reason: 必须经过显式审批后将 authority_status 从 shadow 切换为 production；本次未自动切换

compatibility_stable.reason: 必须有绑定同一 candidate/source 的稳定 compatibility report

external_ugc_boundary.reason: 首次 production 仍应保持 external UGC disabled，待单独 UGC gate

gatebench_clean.reason: GateBench false accept/reject 必须为 0 且 replay determinism 必须为 1

holdout_binding.reason: holdout rows、keyed predictions、replay verification 必须全量匹配

holdout_positive_delta.reason: verified counterfactual holdout 必须通过且相对 baseline 有正 delta

independent_approval.reason: 必须有独立 verifier report、artifact hashes、审批身份和时间戳

projection_clean.reason: projection 必须无 invalid rows 且 status=pass

rollback_artifact.reason: 必须存在可读、hash-bound、runtime_authority=false 的 rollback bundle

runtime_activation.reason: 必须读回 hash-bound activation record 且 authority_status=production

source_commit_bound.reason: 全部 canonical rows 必须绑定 source commit；当前存在未绑定 rows
